calendar: Hoy es el dos de mayo.
es.calendarNote: Days and months normally begin with a lowercase letter in Spanish. Use el with a weekday for a particular day: el lunes means on Monday. Dates use a number followed by de and the month: el dos de mayo.
es.studyNote: El estudiante refers to a male student; la estudiante refers to a female student. El profesor is a male teacher and la profesora a female teacher. Estudio and trabajo are first-person present forms; Spanish often leaves out yo. Keep the accent in inglés.

it.calendarNote: Days and months normally begin with a lowercase letter in Italian. Lunedì has an accented final vowel. A particular Monday needs no preposition in La lezione è lunedì. Dates put the number before the month: il due maggio.
it.studyNote: Use lo before studente because it begins with s plus a consonant. The female form is la studentessa. Il professore is a male teacher, particularly in secondary school; la professoressa is the female form. Studio and lavoro are first-person present forms; io is often omitted.

de.calendarNote: Weekdays and months are nouns and begin with a capital letter. Am Montag means on Monday. A spoken date uses an ordinal number: der zweite Mai means the second of May. The finite verb stays second in these statements.
de.studyNote: Der Student is a male university student; die Studentin is the female form. Der Lehrer is a male teacher and die Lehrerin a female teacher. Lernen can mean learn or study. In einer Schule describes a location and uses dative feminine einer, rather than accusative eine.

ru.calendarNote: Days and months normally begin with a lowercase letter. В понедельник means on Monday. Russian usually omits is in the present tense. Calendar dates use a neuter ordinal and the genitive month: второе мая means the second of May.
ru.studyNote: Студент is a male university student; студентка is the female form. Учитель is a male teacher and учительница a female teacher. Russian has no articles. В школе means in a school and uses the prepositional form школе; the dictionary form is школа.
